assets.prompt: A single blank sealing-wax seal photographed straight from above, centered, on a fully transparent background. Irregular organic outer edge where the melted wax spread and pooled, with a few soft drips and thin translucent edges. In the middle, a smooth, slightly sunken flat circular pressed area about 62% of the diameter, completely blank: no emblem, no letters, no pattern. Subtle realistic wax sheen, tiny bubbles and fine surface ripples near the rim. Soft diffused light from the top-left and a gentle highlight on the raised rim. The wax colour is deep violet purple (#5b3a8c). No shadow outside the wax, no paper, no text. Square 1024×1024, photorealistic macro product shot.
